overview: The Xi Vius Halls were once the ceremonial and martial heart of Akhevan society.
details: Warrior-priests trained, meditated, and performed void rites here. Temporal discipline fields kept their rituals synchronized with Akhevan chronomancy.
hooks: A Xi Vius rite reactivates, drawing voidborn into the halls.
Temporal discipline fields destabilize, fracturing time.
Glyph chambers resonate with forgotten Akhevan chants.
